name: galadon
description: A five-stage engineering loop for agent-built projects: spec, build, verify, ship, learn, with a layout/stack scaffold generator. Pluggable role, template and deploy ports.

interface.shortDescription: A five-stage engineering loop for agent-built projects, with a layout/stack scaffold generator
interface.longDescription: Galadon initializes an agent-ready engineering workspace with one stable loop: spec, build, verify, ship, learn, plus a layout/stack scaffold generator for webapp, service and plugin projects. Role policy, project templates and deployment adapters are pluggable ports; the bundled implementation is a reference, not the framework.
